note: Nucleus wiring table (2026-11-11). One row per nucleus field: what changes upstream, which output moves downstream, and the literal marker that proves the wire is still in core/mind.mjs. Judgement is binary: either the marker is present (wired) or it is not (broken). No 'recorded but unused' state. Immunity check wiring-covered enforces this file against core/mind.mjs, so a row cannot claim a wire that no longer exists.
how_to_test: change the field in nucleus.cur (or delta), run `node core/mind.mjs --dry`, read the output column; if it does not move, the wire is broken
vendor_note: external systems can map their own counters onto these field ids and use the same table; the marker column is ours, the field ids are the contract

fields.effect: retry limit 6 -> 3, precedent suppressed, focus cap +1
rise -> CHRONIC + escalate(chronic-rising) + L2 escalate flag
drop -> HABITLOSS, dispatch-habitual downgraded to dispatch
